summary: Tecnoglass Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its continuation (re-domiciliation) from Cayman Islands to Florida, effective July 7, 2026. The transaction was previously disclosed and approved by shareholders; each existing ordinary share automatically converted into one share of Florida common stock with no change in par value. No price, premium, or financial terms apply. The filing incorporates by reference a proxy statement/prospectus comparison of shareholder rights and tax effects. This is a structural corporate migration, not a special situation. No deal terms are involved.
